question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Explanation of the word "eventually" with its English and Hindi meanings:**

 
 
• **Eventually:** In the end, especially after a long delay, dispute, or series of problems. (आखिर में)
 
• **Example:** After years of training, she eventually became a professional athlete.
 
 
 
• **Explanation of the word "form" with its English and Hindi meanings:**
 
 
• **Form:** To make or be made into a specific shape or structure; to develop or emerge into something. (रूप देना/बनाना)
 
• **Example:** These small cells can form larger structures like tissues and organs.
 
 
 
• In context,** "eventually form" **means that the matter and energy contained in the singularity will eventually develop or create the stars, galaxies, and other structures in the universe.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **form**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Destroy** (नष्ट करना): To put an end to the existence of something by damaging or attacking it.

 
 
• **Example:** The fire destroyed several homes in the neighborhood.
 
 
 
• **Design** (डिज़ाइन करना): To create, fashion, execute, or construct according to a plan.
 
 
• **Example:** He spent hours designing a new logo for the company.
 
 
 
• **Prepare** (तैयार करना): To make ready for use or consideration.
 
 
• **Example:** She prepared a delicious meal for her guests.
